notes: All 16 source and 26 target IDs partitioned exactly once.

*Now when* is one rendering of the opening waw, whose own clause the ASV recasts as a temporal subordinate one, with the two words contiguous at its left edge (rule 55); headed on the coordinator, with the minority corpus reading heading on *when* named in the unit note.

Two ASV coordinators (t009 before *her hope was lost*, t021 before *made him*) stand in clauses whose Hebrew writes no conjunction morpheme at all, so each is its own `added` unit under rule 14's last paragraph rather than folded into a neighbouring verb, for the reason rule 42 gives about a surplus *and*.
